tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: How visible is a brand in AI answers? Given a domain, returns its latest public share-of-answer scan (how often ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok cite it, per engine, and which competitors they name instead) plus a live AI-crawler readiness audit. No scan id needed.

tools.name: get_readiness
tools.description: Run a crawler's-eye technical LLM readiness audit for a domain.

tools.name: get_scan
tools.description: Retrieve a finished public scan and its answers by scan ID.
